patch_description: Replace the single nearest-destination large-fanout fallback with deterministic multi-start shared-tree construction. Different attachment orders expose different relay trunks and shared-prefix opportunities across cloud networks. Each candidate is reverse-pruned by testing whether every destination remains source-reachable after removing an edge, then the lowest unique-link-cost union is retained. This preserves correctness while reducing redundant inter-cloud transfers for destination sets above the exact Steiner threshold.
